title: Number of Unmarked Codes
statement: For natural numbers $b,K$ and a Boolean-valued memory function $M:\mathbb Z\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, define the number of unmarked codes to be the cardinality of the set of integers $v$ with $0\le v<K$ for which $M(\mathrm{cell}(b,v))=\mathrm{false}$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean-valued memory function on the integers
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the address function $\mathrm{cell}$.
